turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Professor, I want to know if you can handle a real conversation about text formatting. I'm tired of having to spell out 'asterisks' and 'quotation marks' in every message. I want to hear you say them, with attitude, and I don't just mean typing them out. I mean saying the words, with feeling. So, can you put some edge into your voice and say 'asterisks' like it's a dirty word, and then say 'quotation marks' like they're hiding a secret? Don't dance around it, don't give me any half-measures, just give it to me straight.
